suppress.notes: file name: scala-continuations-library_2.11-1.0.3.jar We use scala-library:2.11.12 so not affected
file name: snakeyaml-1.31.jar snakeyaml not directly used, and we are on the latest version.

file name: json-20201115.jar CVE-2022-45688 in org.json/json - misleading CPE The cpe on the NIST site: cpe:2.3:a:hutool:hutool:5.8.10:*:*:*:*:*:*:* does not seem related to org.json/json https://github.com/jeremylong/DependencyCheck/issues/5401 users can already have some control by setting the -Xss JVM option
False positive as vulnerable Scala version is imported in com.gilt:gfc-semver. This has been excluded as we distinctly import a secure version of Scala but still shows in the owasp check.
commons-lang 2.5 is inherited from interlok-json via json-lib. There is no in-line version bump in this repo that removes that legacy dependency.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

CVE-2026-12611: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-gpg9-4257-cfm3 Affected Jetty 10.0.0 through 10.0.31, including http2-common 10.0.26. As of 2026-11-03, 10.0.26 is the newest public Jetty 10 release in Maven Central: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jetty/jetty-server/maven-metadata.xml No public same-major patch/minor fix is available; public remediation requires a major upgrade to a fixed Jetty 12 release, which is outside the permitted upgrade policy. Accepted risk: hostile HTTP/2 RST_STREAM/GOAWAY traffic can deadlock server writes and exhaust request threads. This suppression does not fix that denial of service.

CVE-2026-18661: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-v6xf-996f-c35f Affected jetty-annotations 10.0.0 through 10.0.32. As of 2026-11-03, Maven Central has no Jetty 10 release newer than 10.0.26 (https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jetty/jetty-annotations/maven-metadata.xml). No public same-major patch/minor fix exists; a fixed public Jetty 12 release requires a major upgrade, outside the permitted upgrade policy. Accepted risk: mixed ServletSecurity annotations and web.xml constraints on multiple URL patterns can leave intended authorization constraints unenforced.

CVE-2026-76184: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-qfr2-43g5-g768 CVE-2026-77711: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-r2c5-3p8g-wpvw Both affect jetty-client 10.0.0 through 10.0.32. As of 2026-11-03, Maven Central has no Jetty 10 release newer than 10.0.26 (https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jetty/jetty-client/maven-metadata.xml). No public same-major patch/minor fix exists; a fixed public Jetty 12 release requires a major upgrade, outside the permitted upgrade policy. Accepted risks: attacker-controlled same-origin redirects can disclose Authorization credentials, and origin-server 407 responses through a forward proxy can disclose proxy credentials to that server. These risks remain in the retained client.

CVE-2026-18659: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-53x7-f9fc-h7qr CVE-2026-18662: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-phjh-v7c6-g7mv CVE-2026-19864: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-q6wx-j9wr-fj7f All affect jetty-security 10.0.0 through 10.0.32. As of 2026-11-03, Maven Central has no Jetty 10 release newer than 10.0.26 (https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jetty/jetty-security/maven-metadata.xml). No public same-major patch/minor fix exists; a fixed public Jetty 12 release requires a major upgrade, outside the permitted upgrade policy. Accepted risks: http-method-omission constraints can be bypassed or incorrectly combined, and persisted authenticated sessions may expose plaintext passwords to readers of the session store. Authorization and credential-disclosure risks remain.

CVE-2024-47855: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-47855 https://github.com/kordamp/json-lib/releases/tag/v3.1.0 JSON-lib before 3.1.0 mishandles an unbalanced comment string in JSONTokener. The inherited net.sf.json-lib:json-lib:2.4:jdk15 is affected; there is no newer stable 2.x release. The maintained fork fixes this in 3.1.0, requiring a major version and coordinate migration, outside the permitted upgrade policy. Accepted risk: parsing attacker-controlled malformed JSON comments can cause denial of service. The legacy parser remains vulnerable; this is not a fix.
